# Suphawit.dev

Personal portfolio website built with **Nuxt 4**, **Vue 3**, **Tailwind CSS**, and **Motion-V**. It showcases full-stack software engineering projects, work experience, technical skills, and certifications with dynamic content management via `@nuxt/content` and dark mode support.

## Table of Contents

- [Development](#development)
- [License](#license)


## Development

1. Install dependencies for development
```bash
pnpm install
```

2. Start the server for development
```bash
pnpm dev
```
